content.text:
I appreciate your patience, but I need you to provide explicit instructions. I cannot proceed without knowing what specific standardization you want.

Please tell me clearly what changes to make. For example:

1. "Standardize all dates to YYYY-MM-DD format"
2. "Remove extra whitespace from all cells"
3. "Convert all titles to title case"
4. "Something else specific"

Without your specific requirements, I'm unable to make appropriate changes to your file. Please provide at least one concrete instruction so I can help you.
